test_name: Configure Testing Parameters with Advanced Options
description: Validate the ability to configure advanced testing parameters such as environment variables, test frameworks, and suite names.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page using the 'RoostGPT Config' link.
Enter a test suite name in the input field with the test ID '[data-testid="test-name-input"]'.
Select the radio button for 'Cloud' repository type using the test ID '[data-testid="cloud-git-type-radio-button-selected"]'.
Type an environment variable in the input field '[data-testid="new-custom-tag-input"]'.
Click on the 'Download Env Config' button to save the environment configuration.
expected_results: The test suite name is saved successfully.
Environment variables are correctly added and displayed.
Configuration options for 'Cloud' repository type are successfully applied.
Environment configuration is downloaded without errors.
edge_cases: Invalid characters in environment variable input.
Environment configuration download fails due to network issues.
Configuration options are applied but not saved due to server-side errors.
Radio button selection does not reflect correctly.
data_requirements: Correct permissions to download configuration files.
dependencies: RoostGPT Config page must be accessible.
Environment configuration options must be enabled.
API for saving configurations must be functional.
performance_metrics: Time taken to save test suite name.
Response time for downloading environment configuration.
Latency in applying repository type options.
accessibility_requirements: All input fields must be navigable via keyboard.
Radio button selection must have ARIA attributes.
Download button must have accessible labels.
